extracted.name: Sautéed Sweet Plantains (Tajaditas Dulces de Platano)
extracted.description: Platanos or plantains are cooking bananas and are very popular in South America and the Caribbean. This easy dish adds a nice sweetness to any meal.
ingredient_lines: 3 yellow plantains (very ripe), peeled and cut in 1-inch-thick slices
instruction_lines: Round up all your ingredients, and heat peanut oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until butter begins to sizzle.
Gently toss plantain slices with brown sugar, then place into hot oil. Fry until plantains begin to turn golden brown, then turn over, and continue frying until caramelized, about 2 minutes per side.
Drain plantains on a paper towel-lined plate and sprinkle with salt before serving.
